metadata.name: symbol_metadata_example
metadata.purpose: Versioned template for local symbol point-size metadata used by offline research feature generation.
notes: Copy this file to config/symbol_metadata.local.json and fill values from read-only broker symbol metadata for the exact exported symbol.
Do not treat placeholder null values as broker truth.
Do not use current spread snapshots as fixed historical spreads; historical spread must come from price_bars.spread.
